title: potentilla pensylvanica var. litoralis
intro: Potentilla pensylvanica var. litoralis, commonly known as Beach Cinquefoil, is a plant species that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Beach Cinquefoil are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla pensylvanica var. litoralis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
